# Delay, Measurement and Compatibility Checklist: Steadier, Measurable Sharing for Two Full Courts

**Purpose**: Test whether spec 005's requirements are clear, consistent and measurable before
tasks are cut. It covers how delay is defined and measured (FR-001–FR-011, FR-017), and what
older versions and the wire changes promise (FR-015, the additive wire in plan.md).

**Created**: 2026-11-10

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec say whether the scorer's own paired device counts toward FR-010's "every other phone and watch"? That is, the watch of a player who tapped on their phone, or the other way round. [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Is a minimum number of points or minutes per device defined before FR-010's 95% can be judged on a run? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK003 Is there a cap on the share of `unknown` delays, so that FR-010 cannot be met by leaving most points out? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010; Plan Risks sets 10%, the spec does not]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a point that never arrives on a device during a run? Is it a failure of FR-010's "all within 2 s", or outside FR-010? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK005 Does the spec define what a "shared session" is for FR-003's summary? A sharing stint and a match differ since spec 004. [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Key Entities; Research D-4]
- [x] CHK006 Is it specified how long a watch's delay entries may take to reach the phone's record (FR-005)? And what does the summary say when the watch's half is missing? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 Does FR-002 list every connection entry that must carry a radio, including drops caused by the host's Bluetooth restarting (FR-009)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "nothing is wrong" in FR-010 defined by conditions the sharing record can show? "Awake as it would be on court" cannot be read from a record. [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK009 Is "in range" quantified for FR-007 and FR-010, for example as anywhere on two side-by-side courts? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK010 Is "a busy hall" or "other people's devices around" described well enough for a field run or a simulation to reproduce it? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010, US1]
- [x] CHK011 Is FR-006's "within 0.1 seconds of the true time" stated as a bound on every single delay, rather than an average? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK012 Is FR-003's "how long each guest or the host was unreachable" defined: from which event to which, and with what threshold? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK013 Is a "drop" in FR-007 defined? Does it count per connection or per guest, either radio or both, and does it include drops caused by a Bluetooth restart on the host? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Is "on average" in FR-007 and SC-003 defined: averaged over which guests and what length of run? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 Is "replaying that run" in FR-017 defined, so the 25% tolerance has one meaning: same taps, same devices, same drops, same timings? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Is FR-007 (at most 5 drops an hour, MUST) consistent with the plan's two-day time box, which lets FR-007 go unmet and return to clarify? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007; Plan Risks, Research D-7]
- [x] CHK017 Do FR-010 (when nothing is wrong) and FR-011 (otherwise) between them cover every state, with no state falling under neither? [Consistency, Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK018 When one of a guest's two connections drops, does that count as "something wrong" under FR-011, or must FR-010's times still hold under FR-008? The three requirements need to agree. [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK019 Are SC-002 and FR-010 consistent about the conditions of the real-device run: a busy hall, which radios are on, and phones in bags? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK020 Are SC-003's conditions for counting drops the same as FR-007's: in range, both radios in use, and a hall? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK021 Is the delay that User Story 2 says the record shows the same quantity FR-006 bounds, measured from the tap? [Consistency, Spec US2, §FR-001, §FR-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 Can FR-008's "a dropping connection costs no one time" be measured objectively? Is it judged against FR-010's times, or against delays from before the drop? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 Is FR-009's 10 seconds measured from Bluetooth going off, or from it coming back? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK024 Is the 95th percentile the only quantity FR-017 compares? If so, is the assumption that this is enough to trust the nine-guest prediction (FR-016) written down? [Measurability, Assumption, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK025 Does the spec say what calibration may use if the small field run does not load the host enough to pin its throughput? [Gap, Spec §FR-017; Plan Risks]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for delays when a device's clock jumps mid-evening, from a manual change or a network time correction? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK027 Does the spec say whether an undone or corrected point counts toward FR-010, and how its delay is recorded? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK028 Is FR-010 defined for a guest on Wi-Fi alone, with Bluetooth off, as well as the Bluetooth-alone case the Edge Cases name? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-010]

## Older Versions and the Wire

- [x] CHK029 Does FR-015 say which older versions it covers: 1.1 only, or 1.0 as well? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK030 Does "never appear to be on while getting no points" mean appear on the host's list, or on the older device's own screen? Is it consistent with the plan's known 1.0 limit? [Conflict, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015; Research D-14]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for what an older guest is told when the match is full under the raised limit? It understands "no room" but not the new limit. [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK032 Does the spec say how a phone and watch on different app versions count toward the limit, and how their sharing records merge? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK033 Are FR-001, FR-006 and FR-010 defined for points to or from an older device that sends no clock readings? Are they left out of FR-010, or counted as unknown? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-015; Contract wire-protocol.md]
- [x] CHK034 Is the experience of a newer guest on an older (1.1) host specified: no limit shown, and relayed delays unknown? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015; Contract wire-protocol.md]
- [x] CHK035 Is "nothing on the wire that an older build cannot read" a requirement in the spec, or only a choice in the plan? Should it be stated in the spec, given that breaking changes are allowed? [Assumption, Spec §FR-015, Assumptions; Plan Constraints]
- [x] CHK036 Does the spec name the oldest version a host from this release must work with, and how a later breaking change would tell guests? [Gap, Spec §FR-015; Research D-14]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK037 Is the assumption that clocks can be bounded from round trips at court, with no network time, written in the spec, with "unknown" as the stated fallback? [Assumption, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK038 Is the dependency of FR-010 and FR-006 on the delay record (FR-001) existing in released builds written down? Otherwise SC-002 cannot be judged on a run. [Dependency, Spec §FR-001, §SC-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items most likely to change requirements before tasks: CHK003, CHK008, CHK016, CHK018 and CHK030
- Scope: delay, measurement and compatibility only. Release gate, battery and screens were left out at the requester's choice
